services.name: Kick Boxing
services.desc: Kick boxing combines the best foot techniques of karate with the hand techniques of boxing. Students learn numerous explosive kicks to be utilized at a long-range and powerful punches and jabs to be used when close to that opponent. Practicing with boxing gloves and using pads and bags, students get a phenomenal workout while learning to fight off possible attacks.
